model.name: detailView.chainExcludesSelf
model.description: Traceability Chain section excludes the current node (self) and non-chain nodes. Task viewing its own detail must NOT show itself as a chain node (Task is NAVIGATION per 6-step standard). Only req→uc→class→method→impl→test nodes appear. Filter: skip nodes where uuid===current uuid, skip nodes whose type is not in the LOCKED chain types.
